purpose: Track MorroWise internal capabilities that are being evaluated for extraction into the morrowise-product product line.

customer_instance_policy.git_policy: Customer instance data and generated dashboards are runtime data. They must not be committed to Vincent's internal repos.
customer_instance_policy.diagnostics_policy: Diagnostics packages must be explicit, scrubbed, and must not include secrets, tokens, runtime auth files, browser cookies, or customer private data unless Vincent/customer explicitly approves the exact package.
